Name: Little Yuzuki - an Adoptable Child NPC for TotAG
Author: CodysOasis
Description:
[heading]ABOUT[/heading]
There's something in the Glade that Vael doesn't talk about at first.
A presence. Quiet, formless -- a girl without a body, drifting at the edges of the old magic. She's been there a long time. Long enough that she's learned the names of every plant in the clearing, the schedule of every creature that passes through, the particular way light falls between the trees at noon. She knows everything about the world. She just can't touch it.
Her name is [b]Yuzuki[/b].
[b]Little Yuzuki[/b] is a Tales of the Aether Glade expansion that adds Yuzuki, a gentle spirit girl discovered by Vael, as a custom NPC with her own story, friendship arc, and the possibility of becoming part of your family.
[line]
[heading]YUZUKI[/heading]
Yuzuki is timid and cautious, careful with her words until she trusts you. But her curiosity runs deep: she's fascinated by living things, by growth and change, by all the small ordinary miracles of the natural world that she's watched from the sidelines for so long.
When you first meet her, she has no body. She can't interact with anything directly. She exists, and watches, and waits.
Until you and Vael do something about that.
[line]
[heading]THE STORY[/heading]
Yuzuki's arc unfolds across three stages.

[b]The Bear Body[/b]
Working alongside Vael, you craft Yuzuki a stuffed bear body: a soft, plush vessel she can inhabit and finally use to touch things, hold things, and be real. She's shy about it at first. She knocks things over. She learns.

[b]The Human Form[/b]
Raise your friendship with Yuzuki high enough and a new path opens: a ritual, a choice, and a second form. Yuzuki can manifest a human body, though the bear body will always be part of her, in one way or another.

[b]Adoption[/b]
Build a deep enough bond and -- with the help of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36459][b]HaveMoreKids[/b] [/url]-- Yuzuki can become yours. A daughter found in the oldest part of the forest, who smells like lavender and still sleeps curled up with a stuffed rabbit.
[line]
[heading]PERSONALITY & INTERESTS[/heading]
Yuzuki is quiet, curious, and more observant than she lets on. She warms up slowly, but genuinely.

She loves all living things -- plants, animals, bugs, even weeds. She has a particular fondness for cloth and soft things, having spent years tethered to them, and there is something calming about watching things grow that she has never quite been able to explain.

She is also working on being less easily startled, understanding why people shake hands instead of just sitting quietly next to each other, and deciding whether she prefers mornings or evenings. The jury is still out.
[line]
[heading]FEATURES[/heading]
[list]
[*]A fully written custom NPC with a unique three-stage character arc[/*]
[*]Bear body to human form progression tied to friendship[/*]
[*]Gentle, curiosity-driven personality with original dialogue[/*]
[*]Full adoption support via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36459]HaveMoreKids[/url][/*]
[*]Thematic gift preferences rooted in her backstory[/*]
[/list]More coming soon!
[line]
